page.overview:
Who is J. Longo?

J. Longo was a Starfleet officer who lived during the mid-23rd century.

In 2285, they were a lieutenant commander at Starfleet Academy's Starfleet Training Command. They were an instructor. Their office, located on the second level of a building, was in room #210. Their rank, name, position, and office were listed on a directory placard. (, set artwork)
